items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: So Father Carter asked them, well, if he break anything on the drum, that he would pay for him.

ctx.x: Well, that was in 1910. Well, during that time, well, I asked the fellas to let me play. So they said, I wasn't large enough and I didn't think I could fit in no band. So Father Carter asked them, well, if he break anything on the drum, that he would pay for him. He guaranteed that he would pay for him. So I happened to play one number. So after I played that number, it wasn't so good, they asked me to play it that way. And so from that on, that started me out. Well, the next way of them was Emmanuel Perez.
Who was the drummer with Robichaux?
